id: title:haacked:report errors when the postgres fallback omits a flag

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a fallback wrapper and compatibility classification for PostgreSQL cache entries, preserving flag evaluation and avoiding missing-flag errors when cached rows are unsupported or unparseable.
review.reason: The chunk implements a fallback wrapper and compatibility classification for PostgreSQL cache entries, preserving flag evaluation and avoiding missing-flag errors when cached rows are unsupported or unparseable. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the Python-side changes, so the complete behavior and compatibility assertions cannot be fully verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative grouping of a Rust implementation change. No other PRs are supplied, so no cross-PR relationship or unrelatedness can be established. No adoption, incident, or benefit is demonstrated. No tier assignment is made.

observations.behavior: Adds a new v1 classification and a fallback wrapper; removes a blanket falsy-nulling and its tests; retains the typed decoder and its v1 compatibility. P1.F1.H1: Documentation change. P1.F2.H2: Adds a comment and a falsy check. P1.F2.H3: Removes the blanket falsy-nulling and its tests. P1.F3.H2: Adds a fallback wrapper and omit_unsupported_flags. P1.F3.H3: Updates omit_unsupported_
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a fallback wrapper for the PostgreSQL fallback when the hypercache has no entry, omitting unsupported rows and reporting unparseable flags. This could preserve flag evaluation and avoid missing-flag errors when the cache is empty or the row is unsupported.

observations.behavior: Updates omit_unsupported_flags to report omitted rows and retain unsupported flags. P1.F3.H4: Adds a check for unreadable v1 objects. P1.F3.H5: Adds tests for omit_unsupported_flags. P1.F3.H6: Adds a fallback wrapper test. P1.F4.H1: Adds a falsy check. P1.F4.H2: Uses classify_undecodable_v1 instead of UnreadableV1Object. P1.F4.H3: Adds classify_undecodable_v1 and python_reads_
observations.posthog_connection: Classifies v1 documents into unreadable or malformed, preserving compatibility with Python's builder and the typed decoder. This could preserve flag evaluation and avoid missing-flag errors when the cache is empty or the row is unsupported.
